headline: Dominican Christmas bonus maintains amount at US$5,500
summary: The Directorate General of Customs will keep the holiday allowance at US$5,500 for 2026, letting Dominicans abroad bring duty-free goods into the country over Christmas and New Year.
why: Duty-free allowances affect import volumes and retail spending during the holiday season, and customs rules shape tax revenue from cross-border consumer goods.
original_headline: Gracia navideña dominicana mantiene monto de US$5,500
